messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "swallow it with at least 8 ounces (a full glass) of water or other liquid"
set: ["swallow it with at least 8 ounces (a full glass) of water or other liquid", "with a full glass of water", "take with a full glass of water", "mix powder form with at least 4 ounces (one-half cup) of cold water or fruit juice before taking", "interval of at least 8 hours between doses", "take the tablets with a full glass of water", "swallow it whole", "take with no more than 4 ounces of plain water only", "taken with no more than 4 ounces of plain water only", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "swallow the regular tablet whole with a glass of water", "other water pills", "do not mix with any other liquid", "make liquid before taking or giving it", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "adults with obesity or overweight with at least one weight-related condition"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
